title: Update an Offline Event set
content_data:
Use this endpoint to update the name, the Auto Tracking setting, or both of an Offline Event set. > **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/offline/update/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | event_set_id {Required} | string | ID of the Offline Event set that you want to update.
You can get Offline Event set IDs under an advertiser account via [/offline/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1765596808589313). | | name | string | New name for the Offline Event set.
Length limit: 40 characters.
Example: `in_store_purchases`.

Note: You cannot specify a name that has been used by another event set. Otherwise, an error will occur. | | auto_tracking| boolean | Whether to enable Auto Tracking for the Offline Event set.
Enum values: `true`, `false`.
If this field is set to `true`, new campaigns created afterwards under this advertiser account will use this event set for ad tracking and attribution.

Note: The maximum number of auto-tracking Offline Event sets under an advertiser account is 10. If the limit is reached, you cannot change a non-auto-tracking Offline Event set into an auto-tracking one. However, you can delete an existing Offline Event set using [/offline/delete/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1765596790860802). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/offline/update/' --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw '{ "advertiser_id":"{{advertiser_id}}", "event_set_id":"{{event_set_id}}", "auto_tracking":"true" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| advertiser_id | string | Advertiser ID. | #| event_set_id | string | ID of the Offline Event set. | #| name | string | Name of the Offline Event set. | #| description | string | Description that you specified for the Offline Event set.
Returns `""` if no description has been specified. | #| auto_tracking | boolean | Whether Auto Tracking is enabled for the Offline Event set. | #| create_time | string | The time when the Offline Event set was created, in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.
Example: `2023-04-15T00:23:38Z`. | #| update_time | string | The time when the event set was last updated, in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.
Example: `2023-04-15T00:23:38Z`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "name": "{{name}}", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "update_time": "2023-05-05T09:53:02Z", "create_time": "2023-05-05T09:51:47Z", "event_set_id": "{{event_set_id}}", "auto_tracking": true, "description": "{{description}}" } } (/code) ```
